merger.consideration: 1.0 UNP common share plus $88.82 in cash per NSC share
merger.shareholder_approval: NSC special meeting 14-Nov-2025: ~99% of votes cast in favour (8-K 17-Nov-2025, Ex. 99.1)
merger.stb_application: Filed with the Surface Transportation Board 19-Dec-2025 (8-K 19-Dec-2025, Ex. 99.1)
merger.expected_close: 'by early 2027, subject to Surface Transportation Board review and approval within its statutory timeline' (8-K 17-Nov-2025); no closing date had been announced on EDGAR by 19-Nov-2026
merger.model_assumed_close: 2027-06-30 (model assumption for the deal-spread memo; the STB's statutory review timeline from the Dec-2025 application runs into 2027)
merger.restrictions: Share repurchases suspended (prohibited without UNP consent); restrictions on incurring additional indebtedness (Q3-26 10-Q Notes 1, 10; Part II Item 2)
merger.merger_costs: Merger-related expenses $80m in 2025 ($15m Q3, $65m Q4), $145m 9M-26 ($42m Q3-26): retention agreements, advisors, legal (releases)
merger.synergies_public: Companies' joint estimate: $2.75bn annualised EBITDA synergies ($1.75bn revenue, $1.0bn cost); ~$2.1bn incremental capital (DEFM14A 1-Oct-2025; 8-K 19-Dec-2025)

lrp._note: Norfolk Southern management unaudited projections (long-range plan, prepared mid-2025, standalone) as summarised in the joint proxy statement/prospectus (DEFM14A filed 1-Oct-2025, 'Certain Norfolk Southern Unaudited Prospective Financial Information'). Not guidance ('These projections are not, and should not be viewed as, public guidance or targets'). Used as information rows only.

guidance._note: NSC publishes no numeric revenue / operating-ratio / EPS outlook in its EDGAR-filed releases or 10-Qs (outlook commentary is given on earnings calls, which are not on EDGAR). The only EDGAR-filed 2026 planning items are below.
guidance.capex_src: Q3-26 10-Q MD&A: 'For 2026, we expect property additions to approximate $2.1 billion.'
guidance.fuel_q4_26: Q3-26 10-Q MD&A: fuel expense and fuel surcharge revenues for the remainder of 2026 are expected to increase compared with the prior year based on current fuel commodity prices.

debt.at_2025_12_31: Total debt $17,087m (notes & debentures $17,945m face: 4.19% maturing to 2030 $3,030m; 4.28% 2031-35 $2,684m; 4.28% 2037-64 $10,847m; 5.22% 2097-2121 $1,384m; finance leases $18m; discounts, premiums & issuance costs -$876m); current maturities $607m; long-term debt $16,480m (FY2025 10-K Note 11).
debt.maturities_src: FY2025 10-K Note 11 ('Long-term debt maturities subsequent to 2026'); 2026 = current maturities at 31-Dec-2025.
debt.at_2026_09_30: Current maturities $649m; long-term debt $15,964m; total $16,613m (Q3-26 10-Q). 9M-26 debt repayments $618m; no borrowings. Apr-2026 finance lease (Atlanta headquarters) $115m liability recorded (Q3-26 10-Q Note 10; 8-K 2-Apr-2026).
debt.facilities: $800m revolving credit agreement (renewed Jan-2024, expires Jan-2029, undrawn); $800m commercial paper program (Jun-2024, none outstanding); $400m accounts receivable securitization (renewed May-2025, expires May-2026, none outstanding). FY2025 10-K Note 11.
debt.merger_restriction: Merger Agreement restricts incurring additional indebtedness (Q3-26 10-Q Note 10).

buyback.program: $10.0bn authorization from 1-Apr-2022 (board 29-Mar-2022); $6.3bn remaining at 30-Sep-2026; repurchases suspended under the Merger Agreement (no repurchases in 9M-26; $533m / 2.2m shares in 2025). Q3-26 10-Q Part II Item 2.

dividend.note: Quarterly dividend $1.35 per share in 2025 and 2026 (dividends paid $910m in 9M-26; XBRL CommonStockDividendsPerShareDeclared).

eoi.note: Eastern Ohio incident (East Palestine derailment, 3-Feb-2023): operating-expense impact $1,116m 2023; $325m 2024 (net of $650m recoveries); -$190m 2025 (net recoveries; $418m recoveries); $53m 9M-26 ($7m recoveries). Liabilities at 31-Dec-2025: current $609m, non-current $56m (FY2025 10-K Notes 13, 19).

pension.note: Funded status at 31-Dec-2025: pension +$672m (plan assets $2,766m vs obligation $2,094m; $949m in other assets), other postretirement -$125m. FY2025 10-K Note 14.

restructuring.note: Restructuring and other charges: 2024 $183m (voluntary / involuntary separation programs, software rationalization, new COO costs, asset-class disposition; plus $20m OPEB curtailment gain in other income); 2025 $22m (technology restructuring, software rationalization); 9M-26 $6m (severance). Releases.
